purpose: Validate content-addressed resumability across a fresh ChatGPT runtime before production rollout.

transport.reason: 2MiB raw chunks keep Base64 payloads well below the 5,000,000-byte text-create ceiling.

remote_canary_artifact_selection.selection_reason: Largest source payload; exercises multi-chunk reconstruction and maximum transport size.

remote_test_sequence: Create isolated /QROS/artifacts/cas-canary/v1/sha256 subtree only; do not touch production CAS.
Upload the two Base64 chunks for part_04.npz by content hash.
Read both objects back through Dropbox connector.
Verify encoded bytes/hash, decode, verify each raw chunk SHA-256, reconstruct part_04.npz, verify full SHA-256.
Persist a canary artifact manifest and storage receipts in GitHub; do not modify scientific HEAD.
Start a fresh chat/runtime with no dependence on current /mnt/data.
Fresh chat reads GitHub canary manifest, fetches Dropbox chunks, reconstructs payload, verifies exact full SHA-256.
Fresh chat emits CROSS_CHAT_CANARY_PASS receipt only if every hash/size/schema gate passes.
After successful cross-chat recovery, run negative tests: missing chunk must block, corrupted encoded payload must block, wrong ordinal must not silently reconstruct.
Only after all canary gates pass may production protocol be proposed for adoption.
rollback: Delete only /QROS/artifacts/cas-canary after separate explicit confirmation; GitHub canary receipts may remain as immutable test evidence.
